# CHATGPT / AI Project views snapshot

Origin: `pacote/AI Project` of https://github.com/marcelomaurin/CHATGPT,
commit `1448eb8f2fe7d0f42b8cbd4ab0e47830df936df6` (2026-10-20).

Units (LCL): `aiganttview` (`TAIGanttView`), `ainetworkview` (`TAINetworkView`),
`aiboardview` (`TAIBoardView`) and their `*_icon.lrs`, used by the MultiProject
screen. They are identical to the upstream files and use the CHATGPT repository
license (`../LICENSE`).

The MultiProject `.lpi` files search `../CHATGPT/pacote/AI Project` first and
this snapshot second. Change the components upstream first, then synchronize
this copy.
